capabilitiesAudit.description: Reader can click or inspect any factual assertion in a story to view its canonical claim, supporting evidence, primary source reference, confidence score, and caveats.
capabilitiesAudit.evidenceProof: StoryShell renders EvidencePanel and ClaimCard in Deep mode, displaying direct primary source citations (e.g., S.O. 2415(E) and RBI MPC June 2026 resolution).

capabilitiesAudit.description: Reader can ask or view "Where else does this claim, entity, or policy appear?" powered by KnowledgeGraphService dynamic relationships.
capabilitiesAudit.evidenceProof: KnowledgeGraphService projects claim nodes generically in memory (142 claims), but story UI components do not yet surface an interactive "Cross-Story Claim Connections" drawer for readers.

capabilitiesAudit.description: System automatically distinguishes CURRENT, HISTORICAL, SUPERSEDED, and NEEDS_UPDATE facts, surfacing timeline transitions automatically.
capabilitiesAudit.evidenceProof: mgnrega-reform clearly separates MGNREGA 2005 100-day historical data from VB-G RAM G Act 2025 125-day current statutory guarantee (effective July 1, 2026). rbi-repo-rate shows current 5.25% vs historical 6.50% pause.

capabilitiesAudit.description: When credible sources or historical interpretations conflict, system represents disagreement explicitly rather than collapsing into a single false certainty.
capabilitiesAudit.evidenceProof: ClaimCard and EvidencePanel render counterArguments[] arrays and historiography sections (e.g., UN referral debate in Kashmir 1948).

capabilitiesAudit.description: Reader can navigate fluidly: Story -> Claim -> Evidence -> Source -> Entity/Concept -> Related Claims -> Related Stories.
capabilitiesAudit.evidenceProof: KnowledgeLibraryView and StoryShell render interactive links connecting story chapters, claim cards, primary documents, and entity profiles.

readerJourneyTracing.step1StoryStart: Reader opens mgnrega-reform in Standard reading mode.
readerJourneyTracing.step2EvidenceExploration: Reader toggles Deep mode / opens EvidencePanel to inspect S.O. 2415(E) primary gazette citation.
readerJourneyTracing.step3ReturnToNarrative: Reader returns to narrative reading with full trust in the 125-day statutory transition assertion.
readerJourneyTracing.step4StoryCompletion: Reader reaches end of story and reviews key takeaways stat cards.
readerJourneyTracing.step5ContinueLearning: Reader clicks "Continue Learning" to explore related policy entity profiles and cross-story claims.
